relationships.subject: compound 24
relationships.evidence_quote: It was highly selective for the NaV1.8 subtype displaying negligible inhibition of other NaV1.X family members and major cardiac ion channels (pIC50 < 4.5).

key_findings: Virtual screening hit-to-lead optimization yielded urea-derived compound 24, a potent and subtype-selective NaV1.8 inhibitor with 13.9 h rat half-life and DRG Kp,uu of 0.72.
Oral bioavailability of compound 24 in rat was low (6%), a remaining optimization challenge.
